Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Represents PostgreSQL date, including BC dates, its full finite range, and both infinities.
The default value is 2000-01-01.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgDate : IEquatable<PgDate>
```

Implements: [IEquatable&lt;PgDate&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

## Constructors

### PgDate(int)

Creates a date from days relative to 2000-01-01. Int32 extremes represent infinities.

```csharp
public PgDate(int daysSinceEpoch)
```

Parameters:

`daysSinceEpoch` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The signed PostgreSQL day offset.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The finite offset is outside PostgreSQL's date range.
